name: xcode-skills
description: Apple-authored agent skills exported from Xcode 27.3 beta 2 covering SwiftUI best practices, SDK 27 APIs, App Intents, Foundation Models, document-based apps, app resizability, security hardening, C bounds safety adoption, Swift Testing modernization, device interaction, Instruments tracing with xctrace, macOS touch gestures, and Siri app integration and evaluations.

interface.shortDescription: Apple agent skills for SwiftUI, App Intents, Siri, Foundation Models, UIKit, security, and testing
interface.longDescription: Unofficial export of Apple-authored agent skills from Xcode 27.3 beta 2. Covers SwiftUI best practices and SDK 27 APIs, App Intents best practices and SDK 26/27 APIs, Foundation Models sessions, structured output and tool calling, document-based SwiftUI apps, app resizability (including foldable iPhone Duo), Xcode security build settings, C bounds safety adoption, Swift Testing modernization, device/simulator interaction workflows (including foldable hinge control), command-line Instruments tracing with xctrace, direct touch support in macOS apps, making apps work with Siri's model (tool intents, generable entities, Skills bundles, Siri Metadata Analyzer), and SiriEvaluations scenarios.
defaultPrompt: Review my SwiftUI code for best practices.
Audit my Xcode project's security build settings.
Review my App Intents for best practices.
